Academic work

Research

My doctoral research asks where human and robot information processing align, where they diverge, and how interaction can turn those differences into complementary capabilities.

Google Scholar

Doctoral thesis

The thesis uses perception, cognition and response as a framework for investigating misalignment. It connects controlled visual-search experiments, mobile robot interfaces, an interactive chess system and a workshop on human–LLM collaboration.

TU Delft · Defence scheduled for 14 September 2026 · Selected thesis chapters
